pipelines.name: Static Fab merge Saga invocation
pipelines.description: New contract-only child-to-parent transfer of at most 64 wafers. The caller must supply the reconciled durable completed-child result and freeze its merge manifest before admission; that prerequisite is not enforced or certified here. This pipeline is not automatically chained after split. Fixture adapters are unbound host requirements.

steps.name: Invoke fab-merge v1
steps.description: Invoke fab-merge v1 once with its own operation/stage occurrence and completed-child manifest; never reuse the split transaction identity or treat compensation as success.

pipelines.name: Fab split, await child, merge design boundary
pipelines.description: Document-only composition, not a runnable pipeline. Split and merge invocation contracts are independent segments. Execution v1 has no supported bounded durable child-route start/reattach/completion policy; do not replace this gap with a pure port, implicit success or dynamic insertion.

steps.name: Split parent wafers into an existing child
steps.description: Freeze a bounded manifest and confirm fab-split success before separately admitting child work. New child creation is a host prerequisite, not an owned command in this example.

steps.name: Await separately owned child Monarch work
steps.description: DOCUMENT-ONLY GAP between fab-split v1 and fab-merge v1. A host must durably identify and bound the child plan, persist start intent, reattach after restart, reconcile unknown effects and confirm its completed wafer manifest. No child policy or implementation is bound; this stage has no execution or port declaration.

steps.name: Merge only the durable completed child result
steps.description: Only after independently confirmed child completion may a host freeze the merge manifest and supply durable initial args to fab-merge-invoke. Split and merge use distinct Saga/version, stage and occurrence identity scopes.

pipelines.name: Static Fab split Saga invocation
pipelines.description: New contract-only parent-to-child transfer of at most 64 wafers. The target child must already exist and the manifest must be frozen before admission; child creation and processing are not implemented by this pipeline. Fixture adapters are unbound host requirements.

steps.name: Invoke fab-split v1
steps.description: Invoke fab-split v1 once with durable initial Lot IDs, wafer set and frozen manifest; await Saga success before confirming this transfer only.

sagas.name: Split a frozen wafer set into a child Lot

payload.purpose: Move an identified frozen set from source Lot to a pre-created target child Lot.
invariants: Frozen manifest and wafer identities are conserved

sagas.name: Merge a completed child Lot back into its parent

payload.purpose: Move the exact frozen child wafer set to its parent under a separate transaction identity. This static example is not multi-source expansion.
invariants: Frozen manifest and wafer identities are conserved
